setup.welcome: Welcome! Pick a product, pay via UPI QR and get your codes instantly.
setup.terms:
1. BUY karne se pehle apni SCREEN RECORDING ON kar lein.
2. Screen recording ke bina NO REFUND / NO REPLACEMENT milega.
3. Payment sirf diya gaya QR scan karke karein, exact amount ka.
4. Codes ek baar use hone ke baad repeat nahi hote.
5. Galat amount / galat UPI se payment hone par refund nahi milega.
